question: Which supreme court judge has surved in international court of justice?
text:
If you mean the **Supreme Court of India**, two former judges served on the International Court of Justice (ICJ):

- **Justice Dalveer Bhandari** joined the ICJ on April 27, 2012, and was re-elected in 2017 for a nine-year term beginning in February 2018. ([sci.gov.in](https://www.sci.gov.in/judge/justice-dalveer-bhandari/?utm_source=openai))
- **Justice R. S. Pathak**, a former Chief Justice of India, served on the ICJ from 1989 to 1991. ([sci.gov.in](https://www.sci.gov.in/judge/justice-r-s-pathak/?utm_source=openai))
